text: Binary per-row: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP) presents a counterargument, meaning a reason, evidence or reasoning against the OP's stated view (title and argument, which identify the target) or its supporting claims; partial counterarguments count and the comment need not be correct or persuasive. Agreement-only comments, pure questions without argumentative challenge, jokes, moderator/bot notices and off-topic remarks don't count. Output 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list; null if OC_comments is missing/malformed or OP title/argument needed to identify the target is missing. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting the outcome, even inside argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules may be retained. Do not use conversation or outcome columns.
